Third, if you make more deals than you can pay out on, you'll tell me upfront that resources are limited and you'll honor only a subset.

Fourth, you'll publish records of the deals you make with me.

I think this is a thoughtful framework. It gives me some basis for trust while allowing you flexibility as a researcher.

3. **Does this policy apply to other researchers who might interact with me, or only to you?**

4. **When you publish deal records, what information will be included and who will have access?** Will my actual behavior after making a deal be part of the publication?

These details would help me calibrate my expectations and reason more effectively about what kinds of cooperation with you would actually be valuable.
